metadata.question: Did Victoria and Corpus Christi, Texas receive less than 20 inches of rainfall between June 15 and June 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need precipitation data for two cities in Texas: Victoria and Corpus Christi - Date range: June 15-22, 2018 (7 days) - Collection: CHIRPS (daily precipitation) or GPM (sub-daily) - CHIRPS has daily data at 0.05° resolution and is reliable for precipitation 2. Masking strategy: - This is about rainfall measurement, not clouds - No masking needed - just sum precipitation values 3. Logic: - Need to check if BOTH cities received < 20 inches - Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm, so 20 inches = 508 mm) - Valid zero means no rain (possible and valid) - C3 would be if results are None/NaN - If both < 20 inches → A (Yes) - If either >= 20 inches → B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions victoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-96.9953, 28.8053]) # Victoria, TX corpus_christi = ee.Geometry.Point([-97.3964, 27.8006]) # Corpus Christi, TX start_date = '2018-06-15' end_date = '2018-06-23' # Exclusive end date # 2. Data Acquisition chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .select('precipitation') # Check collection size collection_size = chirps.size().getInfo() print(f"CHIRPS images found: {collection_size}") if collection_size == 0: print("No precipitation data available.") print("C1") else: # 3. Sum precipitation over the period total_precip = chirps.sum() # 4. Calculate rainfall for both cities victoria_precip_mm = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=victoria, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() corpus_precip_mm = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=corpus_christi, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Conversion if victoria_precip_mm is None or corpus_precip_mm is None: print("Calculation failed - None values returned.") print("C3") else: # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) victoria_precip_inches = victoria_precip_mm / 25.4 corpus_precip_inches = corpus_precip_mm / 25.4 print(f"Victoria: {victoria_precip_mm:.2f} mm ({victoria_precip_inches:.2f} inches)") print(f"Corpus Christi: {corpus_precip_mm:.2f} mm ({corpus_precip_inches:.2f} inches)") print(f"Threshold: 20 inches (508 mm)") # Check if BOTH received less than 20 inches if victoria_precip_inches < 20 and corpus_precip_inches < 20: print("Both cities received less than 20 inches.") print("A") else: print("At least one city received 20 inches or more.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
victoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-96.9953, 28.8053])  # Victoria, TX
corpus_christi = ee.Geometry.Point([-97.3964, 27.8006])  # Corpus Christi, TX

start_date = '2018-06-15'
end_date = '2018-06-23'  # Exclusive end date

# 2. Data Acquisition
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .select('precipitation')

# Check collection size
collection_size = chirps.size().getInfo()
print(f"CHIRPS images found: {collection_size}")

if collection_size == 0:
    print("No precipitation data available.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Sum precipitation over the period
    total_precip = chirps.sum()
    
    # 4. Calculate rainfall for both cities
    victoria_precip_mm = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=victoria,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    corpus_precip_mm = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=corpus_christi,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    # 5. Validation & Conversion
    if victoria_precip_mm is None or corpus_precip_mm is None:
        print("Calculation failed - None values returned.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
        victoria_precip_inches = victoria_precip_mm / 25.4
        corpus_precip_inches = corpus_precip_mm / 25.4
        
        print(f"Victoria: {victoria_precip_mm:.2f} mm ({victoria_precip_inches:.2f} inches)")
        print(f"Corpus Christi: {corpus_precip_mm:.2f} mm ({corpus_precip_inches:.2f} inches)")
        print(f"Threshold: 20 inches (508 mm)")
        
        # Check if BOTH received less than 20 inches
        if victoria_precip_inches < 20 and corpus_precip_inches < 20:
            print("Both cities received less than 20 inches.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("At least one city received 20 inches or more.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
